notes: Every polygon metric is authored triangle count, not GPU cost.
Sample pose is Stand at 20% when present, otherwise the first sequence at 20%.
LOD0 includes null, negative shared, and zero LevelOfDetail only. Hero glow is removed only from body count.
File size is MDX/MDL bytes; texture files are separate. Diffuse sheet count measures sampled visible material TextureID paths, normalized by case, not texture memory.
Raw body height is sampled non-glow LOD0 geometry without game object modelscale; it is not game-rendered height. Missing body bounds remain null rather than becoming zero height.
Category aliases are preserved. Resource-level Hive categories can include auxiliary models.
